call_count = 0

def my_dep():
    global call_count
    call_count += 1
    return "hello"

@app.get("/", dependencies=[Depends(my_dep, scope="function")])
def read_root(dep=Depends(my_dep)):
    return {"call_count": call_count}

    global call_count
    call_count = 0

if __name__ == "__main__":

        test_scope_function()
        print("Test passed!")
